$comment: Thresholds for tools/monitor/check.mjs (run hourly by .github/workflows/monitor.yml). A feed is down when its last successful fetch is older than maxStaleMinutes.
label: outage
titlePrefix: แหล่งข้อมูลล่ม:

groups.$comment: Default per snapshot group. edge = Cloudflare cron every 10 min. runner = GitHub Actions every 30 min, but GitHub schedules can lag 2-3 h, so allow 6 h.

feeds.$comment: Per-feed overrides of the group default, e.g. "radar": { "maxStaleMinutes": 180 }.

$ignoreComment: flood (bma-flood) and rain (bma-rain) are known blocked: BMA answers 403 to both Cloudflare and GitHub Actions IPs. Remove them from ignore once a working fetch path exists.
